name: Ocean Beach
summary: The postcard coastal strip of Vice City celebrated for pastel Art Deco architecture, supercars cruising Ocean Drive, and sprawling sunny shorelines.
description: Ocean Beach features white sand coastlines teeming with beachgoers, rollerbladers, and lifeguard towers flanked by palm trees. By night, Ocean Drive illuminates in brilliant pink, turquoise, and violet neon, serving as the social hub for exotic vehicle showcases.

seo.title: Ocean Beach: Ocean Drive & Coastal Guide
seo.description: Discover Ocean Beach in GTA VI. Guide to Ocean Drive luxury hotels, cruising strips, beach activities, and landmarks.
